subject: Intro call availability and timezone notes — Jared Lim
messages:
From: Jared Lim <jared.lim@gmail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: Intro call — availability (BST)

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick reply on LinkedIn — I'd love to do a short intro phone screen for the Staff ML Engineer role. I'm based in London (BST, currently UTC+1). My windows over the next few days: 

- Fri 26 Jun: 09:30–11:30 BST (14:30–16:30 UTC)
- Mon 29 Jun: 13:00–15:00 BST
- Tue 30 Jun: 08:00–10:00 BST or 18:00–19:00 BST (if after work)

If you can propose a 25–30 minute slot, happy to confirm. I attached my resume and can send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Also happy to do Google Meet / phone — phone number is +44 7700 900123.

Best,
Jared Lim
Senior ML Engineer
jared.lim@gmail.com
Attachment: Jared_Lim_Resume.pdf (pdf, 128KB)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Lim <jared.lim@gmail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call — availability (BST)

Hi Jared — thanks for sending over availability and the resume, appreciate the clear windows. 

We'd like to offer two 25-minute options that should work across timezones:

Option A: Fri 26 Jun 10:00 BST / 02:00 PDT (25m) — early for us but doable
Option B: Mon 29 Jun 13:30 BST / 05:30 PDT (25m) — more mid-day for both sides

Because you mentioned an evening on Tue, we can also do:
Option C: Tue 30 Jun 18:15 BST / 10:15 PDT (25m)

Quick note on dial-in: we usually do Google Meet for initial screens; if you'd prefer a phone call we'll call +44 7700 900123. If Google Meet is fine I'll send an invite.

I copied Marissa (recruiting ops) to help with calendar logistics — she can send an .ics and confirm. If none of these work, tell me which of your original windows you'd prefer and I'll propose another.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Recruiter — Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124
Attachment: Redwood_intro_ics_hs_20260625.ics (invitation stub)

Thanks Hannah — Option B on Mon 29 Jun at 13:30 BST works best for me. Google Meet is fine. Please send the invite and I'll accept. 

One small ask: could the calendar invite include the hiring manager's name (I assume this will be a 1:1) and whether I should prepare any code sample or system design topic in advance? If not necessary, that's fine.

Cheers,
Jared
